personality.summary: Rigid, duty-bound and nearly expressionless, but not devoid of paternal feeling.

relationships.ikki-kurogane: Son whose existence threatens Kurogane order; Itsuki proposes severance yet asks whether Ikki truly wants him as father and finally praises his growth.
relationships.stella-vermillion: Ikki's lover; he politely greets her and briefly softens the awkwardness by mentioning Ikki once practiced greeting her father.
relationships.ouma-kurogane: Eldest son and family prodigy, fighting on another block of the festival.

periods.summary: Itsuki visits Ikki in the infirmary after the Byakuya match. He politely introduces himself to Stella, then proposes severing his parent-child relationship with Ikki because Ikki's rise as an F-rank undermines the Kurogane family's role as guardian of rank-based order. He is not merely trying to protect the family's face: before the Sara match he asks whether Ikki is truly willing to keep such a father, admitting he cannot cheer for or congratulate Ikki because he was raised to be discipline itself. Ikki rejects severance and reframes their conflict as an ordinary father-son fight. Itsuki accepts that answer and tells Ikki he has become a great person.

key_events.summary: Proposes cutting legal parent-child ties after Ikki reaches the top eight.
Receives Ikki's refusal and offers rare praise before the Sara match.
